## What changes and why

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior, and resulting behavior. Explain why this approach fits the problem.

## Specification

Link the scoped spec and list the acceptance criteria addressed by this PR. Identify the associated project skill when applicable.

## Observed evidence

Record exact commands, results, tested commit, dirty-tree state, and relevant environment assumptions. Attach focused screenshots or artifacts when they help review. Distinguish local verification from actual remote CI runs; identify skipped or pending checks explicitly.

## Risks and limitations

Describe material behavior, compatibility, or verification limitations. Keep unrelated speculation out of the review.

## Rollback

Describe the smallest safe reversal and whether it needs a data or dependency migration.
